facts.fact: Greece has over 6,000 islands, yet only about 200 are inhabited, making it home to more islands than any other country in the Mediterranean.
facts.flagElement: the cluster of small white circles in the upper left quadrant

facts.fact: Ancient Greeks invented the first known analog computer, the Antikythera mechanism, a bronze astronomical calculator recovered from a 2,000-year-old shipwreck.
facts.flagElement: the bronze gear or cog wheel in the center

facts.fact: Greece produces more olive oil per capita than any other country, with olive trees that can live for over 2,000 years and still bear fruit.
facts.flagElement: the green olive branch extending from the lower right
